data.name: Gregory
data.gender_notes: Gregory is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Gregory comes from the Greek word 'gregor', which means 'watchful, alert, or awake'. This name was given to babies born during the early Christian era, symbolizing the new spiritual awareness and watchfulness of the parents towards their child's spiritual growth. The name Gregory carries the meaning “Watchful, alert, or awake” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Gregory usually hope their child will grow to embody watchful, alert, or awake and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes vigilance and awareness towards one's spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Gregory belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Watchful, alert, or awake.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gregory total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: גרגורי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גרגורי הוא שם נבואי בעברית שמשמעותו האמיתית היא 'האדם הנאמן' או 'המאמין'. שם זה נראה לראשונה בספר יוחנן 10:16, בכאפניד עבר, בערבית, 'אנשי האומנה', או 'האומנים' (John 10:16). בפוליביבלי, 'אומנה' (אומנות, האמונה), 'נאמן' (אדם נאמן, שותף, כופר), 'אומן' (אדם שהאמונה). בערבית, ג'רג'ורי (جرجوري) 'אדם שהאמונה, אדם נאמן, שותף, כופר'. בעברית, 'גרגורי' (גרגורי), 'אדם שנאמן, אדם שמאמין'.

in_greek.name: Γρηγόριος
in_greek.meaning: ονομασία: ο άνθρωπος που πιστεύει, ο άνθρωπος που εμπιστεύεται
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Γρηγόριος είναι ένα εκκλησιαστικό όνομα με ετυμολογία από το όνομα του άγγελου του Θεού, ο οποίος εμφανίζεται στο Ευαγγέλιο του Ιωάννη 10:16. Η λέξη «Γρηγόριος» προέρχεται από το ελληνικό «γρηγορέω», που σημαίνει «να φυλαχτεί somebody» και «να φυλάσκεται somebody». Οι Βυζαντινοί και οι Ρωμιοί χρησιμοποίησαν το όνομα «Γρηγόριος» ως εκκλησιαστικό όνομα για χάρη του Αγίου Γρηγορίου του Παναμά, που ήταν ο ιδρυτής του μοναστηριού της Παναμίας και των Παναμιαίων. Το όνομα «Γρηγόριος» είναι συνδεδεμένο με την πίστη, την εμπιστοσύνη, την προστασία και την προστασία του ανθρώπου.

in_latin.name: Gregorius
in_latin.meaning: nominatio: homo fidelis, homo qui credit
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gregorius est nomen Ecclesiae ex Evangelio Ioannis 10:16. Lex Gregorius a Graeco verbo gratia et creditus, significans fidem et credere. Ecclesia Graecorum et Romanorum nomen Gregorius ut nomen Ecclesiae usi sunt in honorem Sancti Gregorii, qui fuit fundator monasterii Panamiae et Panamiaei. Nomen Gregorius est connectus cum fide, credulitate, et protectione humani.

in_english.name: Gregory
in_english.meaning: name: one who is faithful, one who believes
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gregory is a Christian name derived from the name of the angel of God, appearing in the Gospel of John 10:16. The name Gregory comes from the Greek word Gratia and Creditus, meaning faith and belief. In the early Christian Church, the name Gregory was used in honor of Saint Gregory, who was the founder of the monastery of Panamia and the Panamians. The name Gregory is associated with faith, trust, and the protection of humanity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gregory became popular in the Western world during the Middle Ages, particularly due to the influence of influential figures such as St. Gregory the Great, Pope Gregory I, and the Gregorian Chants. It is also the name of several rulers,: including St. Gregory of Nazianzus, Gregory of Nyssa, and King Gregory of Scotland, among others.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Gregory holds a deep spiritual significance as a reminder of the importance of staying alert and watchful in one's spiritual journey. It serves as a constant reminder of the importance of being aware of God's presence in one's life and striving towards spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Gregory: Deriving from the Latin 'gregorios' meaning 'watchful' or 'guardian', Gregory symbolizes vigilance, protection, and wise guidance. Spiritually, it represents the role of a shepherd, caring for and guiding God's flock.

biblical_reference.note: The name Gregory is mentioned in the Gospel of John 10:16 as an angel of God.

historical_references.reference: Gregory of Nazianzus was a notable Christian theologian and bishop of the 4th century. He is considered to be a Doctor of the Church and a major figure in the development of Christian theology. He is known for his role in the Councils of Constantinople and his philosophical and theological writings, which continue to influence the Christian tradition.
historical_references.context: Early Christian Church and the development of theology

historical_references.reference: Gregory I, also known as Gregory the Great, was a Pope of the Catholic Church in the 6th century. He was instrumental in reforming the papacy and the administration of the Church, and is considered the last Roman emperor in the west. He also sent missionaries to England, where they established the Anglican Church.
historical_references.context: Roman Catholic Church and the spread of Christianity in Europe
